For those who experience problem with upgrading fitbit to latest version To solve issue I recommend using following trick:

  1. Download and install Fitbit Connect;
  2. Turn off cable\wifi from your notebook\pc;
  3. Use mobile network on your mobile (not WiFi);
  4. Connect your mobile (which should have internet connection) to your notebook\pc and choose USB tethering;
  5. Use original fitbit dongle;
  6. Run Fitbit connect and choose update;
  7. Login to your fitbit account and choose tracker;
  8. Wait couple minutes while tracker updating

All these steps look like magic but it works for me second time (when any other advice's - not). The same algorithm work also for case when you cannot sync your tracker (or add new device to account).
